title: Rustic's Bottles Create Patch
description: Adds Create Mod support to Rustic's Bottles
body:
---

Adds [Create Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) support to [Rustic's Bottles](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/rusticsbottles)

#### Instructions for use:

- Download latest release and move it to the resource pack folder like normal
- Extract the file named "DATAPACK.zip" from the zip file downloaded **(Don't unzip the DATAPACK.zip)**
- either download [KubeJS](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs) and place the DATAPACK.zip into kubejs/data folder, or install the datapack like you would into a world.

This is needed because without Create changes how some bottles and items are rendered, standing up instead of lying down like others.
  

#### If you encounter any bugs or have a suggestion, please report it on my [Github page](https://github.com/Rustic-Potatoes/rusticsbottles-create-patch/).
